args.title: Persist selected format in ExportButton
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Update the ExportButton component to persist the user's selected format and reuse it for future exports. This will enhance user experience by remembering their preference instead of defaulting to CSV each time.

label: feature
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The ExportButton component defaults to CSV format via `defaultFormat = "csv"`. To implement the requested feature, the component should persist the selected format and re-use it.
